amortization: Reusable setup is reported as declared. When the plan says equal-split-over-planned-runs, the report shows the per-run share beside the total; it is never folded into session time.

fields.unit: position among all launched runs of the trial, 1-based
times a tool request or input had to be repaired outside the answer
whole minutes of human or coordinator time on those repairs
post-answer correction rounds, recorded separately from the original run
whole minutes spent on those rounds
questions or decisions put to the Director for this run
whole minutes of Director time, as declared
cold, warm or unknown, as exposed by the surface
text: the tested model's prior involvement with this material, or null

operation_unit: One tool invocation by the tested session, successful or failed, as recorded by the session surface. Both conditions use this unit.
preparation_timing: Mechanical: the seal command's own machine clock from start to the seal write. Declared: setup minutes supplied by the preparation owner in the plan.
session_start: The first byte of PROMPT.md sent to the fresh session.
session_stop: The last byte of the session's final message.
unknown: null or unknown means unknown and is reported as unknown, never 0.
